description: This file contains the implementation of the NativeZilkerClient class, which manages the lifecycle (start, stop, restart) of a native Zilker client process, handles configuration setup, and includes process control and debugging features within a larger software test framework.

classes.name: NativeZilkerClient
classes.description: A class responsible for managing a native Zilker client process, including starting, stopping, configuration setup, and debugging tools within a test automation framework.

methods.name: getCpeId
methods.description: Returns the generated CPE ID for this client instance.

methods.name: setGenericPropConfig
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the generic properties configuration map.

methods.name: setClientConfigCustomizer
methods.description: Sets a customizer for client configurations.

methods.name: setIncludePackagedWhitelist
methods.description: Configures whether to include packaged whitelist in the configuration.

methods.name: setStartActivated
methods.description: Configures the client to start in an activated state and updates relevant properties.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes configuration and starts the Zilker client process if not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the client process, optionally performing a clean shutdown with IPC communication.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the client process by stopping and then starting it again.

methods.name: doBacktrace
methods.description: Attempts to produce a backtrace of the running process using gdb if available.

methods.name: isConflictingClientRunning
methods.description: Checks if another client is already running by attempting to bind a well-known IPC port.

methods.name: isProcessStarted
methods.description: Checks if the client process has been started.
